## Player.setRollbackPredictedInputs() method

Sets the raw input keys that should be sequenced with rollback prediction.

**Signature:**

```typescript
setRollbackPredictedInputs(inputs?: readonly (keyof InputSchema)[]): void;
```

## Remarks

This preserves the existing game-facing input API. Games can keep reading `player.input.q`<!-- -->, `player.input.e`<!-- -->, etc. and only opt specific keys into rollback sequencing when they affect deterministic character state.
